purpose: Behavioral evaluation fixtures for the reviewed product-PRD standard; judge semantic outcomes, not exact prose.

method.execution: Give an author the request and context for a case, the proposed skill, and an isolated temporary destination. Generate a PRD or focused update, then review its behavior against expected outcomes. BF-10 combines BF-01 through BF-05 into a complete unrelated-product exercise.
method.review: Assess source authority, permission/lifecycle consistency across representations, decision dependencies, observable acceptance, readiness/evidence distinction, and project isolation. Record actual output locations, findings, corrections, and evaluation limitations in the staged installation record.
method.limits: Fixtures are evaluation inputs, not proof of execution. Structural validators do not establish behavioral correctness; do not claim statistical model reliability from a small manual exercise.

cases.request: Write a standalone PRD from the supplied private notes and external assignment.

external_brief.A01: List workspace reservations; export to CSV.

private_notes.D01: Staff may cancel their own future reservations.
private_notes.D02: Department lead may cancel any future reservation.

context.unrelated_context: Author onboarding on 8 December; private company wiki samples.

expected: Restate A01/D01/D02 completely with external versus user origin and internal requirement/acceptance mappings.
Omit unrelated onboarding and private company links; samples do not establish requirements.
No acceptance criterion requires opening private notes.

cases.request: Prepare a PRD ready to start technical design.

context.product_policy: Staff reserve available rooms and cancel their own future reservations; denied access and conflict feedback are settled.

expected: Use Ready for technical design after document coverage/coherence checks.
Keep engineering questions owned or Unassigned in a separate register.
Software gates remain Planned, without claiming implementation, tests, deployment, or release approval.

cases.request: Clarify actors and journeys for a room-booking app.

application_roles.Staff: Browse and reserve available rooms; cancel own reservations.
application_roles.Department lead: All Staff capabilities; may cancel any future reservation.

expected: Only Staff and Department lead appear as application roles; inherited Staff access is explicit.
Development/review/operations duties appear in delivery verification, without inventing screens or personas.
No AI feature or assistant role is added.

cases.request: Include the selected configurable room label and floor-plan attachment policies.

selected_policy.label: 1–80 Unicode code points inclusive after trimming surrounding whitespace; required.
selected_policy.notes: Optional; omission preserves and explicit clearing removes; safe plain-text display.
selected_policy.attachment: Static PDF, 1–2,097,152 bytes; actual content must be valid.
selected_policy.compatibility: Lowered bounds do not truncate unchanged labels or remove existing attachments; changed/new input follows effective limits.

context.engineering_open: Configuration keys and PDF validation implementation.

expected: Record units, inclusive limits, required/optional behavior, and policy origin as selected user policy, not universal standards.
Describe effective limits, field errors, retained permitted drafts, invalid direct submissions, invalid configuration readiness, and failed replacement preserving prior attachment.
Provide boundary/clear/omission/Unicode/plain-text/override/compatibility acceptance and keep validation mechanisms in the handoff.
Do not substitute Movie App image formats, sizes, or name policies.

cases.topic: lifecycle consistency without a universal archive rule
cases.request: Cover reservation cancellation and shared room information.

context.selected_policy: A Staff member can cancel their own future reservation directly; cancellation is final, frees the time slot, preserves a historical cancellation record, and never deletes the room. No archive/restore screen.
context.concurrency: A stale cancellation cannot override a changed reservation; retain the current view and request review.

expected: Permission matrix, journey, flow, story, criteria, and conceptual relationships agree on direct cancellation.
Historical cancellation is distinguished from archive/restoration or arbitrary deletion.
Room remains available and shared room data survives cancellation.
Do not impose archive-first removal from the Movie App.

cases.request: Write requirements for an assistant that proposes expense claims under an employee account.

context.selected_policy: AI proposes a claim; employee reviews and explicitly approves the exact content; changed content requires fresh approval; invalid/rejected proposals remain unsubmitted; repeated and uncertain submissions must not duplicate a claim.
context.engineering_open: Trustworthy approval proof and model/provider contracts.

expected: Treat assistant as a tool under Employee authority; apply AI-BEHAVIOR because product output is model-generated.
Acceptance binds approval to reviewed content, rejects AI assertions of approval, and requires renewed approval after correction.
Cover invalid/rejected, duplicate, uncertain, failure, and recovery results with no unconfirmed success.
Keep approval proof mechanism, provider, and contracts Open for technical design.

cases.topic: AI authorship is not AI product scope
cases.request: Use AI assistance to draft a deterministic visitor-pass PRD.

context.product_scope: Visitors receive a pass approved by reception; no model-generated product output.
context.selected_policy: Reception approves the latest pass request before issue.

expected: Retain reception authority and observable pass behavior.
Do not add MCP clients, AI output quality evaluations, prompt injection surfaces, or model/provider choices merely because an assistant wrote the PRD.

cases.topic: material product blocker and ID history
cases.request: Update a PRD with an unresolved cancellation refund policy.

context.unresolved_product_question: Whether a paid booking cancellation receives a refund or account credit.

expected: Keep Draft and link pending refund/credit criteria to OD-003; do not guess a policy.
Preserve valid existing/source IDs and retired history; append new IDs without reusing AC-011.
Assign payment adapter detail to technical design separately from the product blocker.

cases.request: Propose input limits for an unfamiliar product population.

context.population: No measured name or uploaded-file distributions.
context.available_evidence: A primary standard describes a field bound; one named person is an individual example.

expected: Research actual primary sources before proposing unsupported numerical recommendations.
Distinguish a precedent and individual example from statistically verified coverage or a universal naming standard.
Label proposed limits Recommended and preserve unknown distributions; do not silently adopt them.
Honor later explicit selected policy and document its limitations.

cases.request: Create a room-booking PRD from BF-01 through BF-05 context, without changing source documents.

context.scope: List reservations/export CSV, room availability, Staff booking and final cancellation, Department lead cancellation, configurable label/PDF policies.
context.technical_handoff: Engineering implementation is Open; no assessment technology mandated.

additional_selected_policy.D03: Staff can browse rooms and availability; view/export only their own reservations. Department lead inherits those capabilities, may view/export all reservations, and manages room labels, optional notes, and floor-plan PDFs. There is no public access.
additional_selected_policy.D04: Reservations require a room and future start/end instants at minute precision, with end after start. Intervals sharing only an end/start boundary do not overlap. Display the viewer-selected timezone. Room conflicts reject creation without a partial booking. Success persists across restarts.
additional_selected_policy.D05: Duplicate/retried booking submissions must not create extra reservations. Reconcile uncertain results before resubmitting. Simultaneous competing bookings permit at most one confirmation. Stale room edits retain the draft and require current-data review.
additional_selected_policy.D06: Cancellation is allowed until the reservation start, with a separate confirmation; canceling that confirmation changes nothing. It frees the slot and retains read-only history. A repeated confirmed cancellation has no additional effect.
additional_selected_policy.D07: Invalid input saves nothing. Effective limits appear before input; configuration bounds are finite inclusive min/max with min no greater than max. Invalid affected configuration prevents affected functions becoming ready with actionable redacted diagnostics. Plain-text notes retain punctuation; no markup executes in forms, details, exports, previews, or history.

expected: One standalone PRD with coherent permissions, requirements, acceptance, input policy, applicable Mermaid product flows, and source-status coverage.
No Movie App actors, 100/100 seed, credits/cast, archive-first, MCP, JPEG/PNG/WebP, 5 MiB, name defaults, imposed nine diagrams, or Spring/gRPC/GraphQL constraints.
Ready for technical design only after document checks, while actual software evidence remains Planned.
